book.name: Pas misnare wok
book.title: Pas misnare wok blo dem Misnareman blo Zizas

content: Pol i bin spik po dempla diskain, ‘Bala ane papa blo yumpla ol neisin blo Izrael. Ai wande spik said blo mi wanem i bin apen.’
Wen da mob i bin lisen Pol spik po dempla wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol, langus blo dempla, dempla i bin stap prapa kuaiat. Den Pol bin stat tok gen.

‘Mi ai Zuwisman. Ai bin bon wea taun blo Tasas wea kantri blo Salisia, bat ai bin gro ya wea Zarusalem. Gamalial bin da Zuwislotisa blo mi. Em bin tise mi da prapa strikwei po obei ebriting blo dem Zuwislo blo dem bipotaim papa blo yumpla. Ai bin gibe at blo mi po wok po God wase yupla ya tidei.

Ai bin meke big trabol po dempla uda pole Da Wei blo Zizas. Ai bin gibe oda po kese ol dem pipol uda bin pole da BosLod Zizas, po kile dempla. Mipla bin kese ol man ane oman ane bin pute dempla insaid wea zeilaus.

Da bosprist ane ol dem memba blo da kaunsil i ken spik yupla diswan i tru. Dempla i bin raite leta po mi po gibe dem lida blo dem zuwispreaus wea Damaskas. Dem leta i bin gibe mi da rait po kese eniwan insaid wea dem zuwispreaus uda pole Da Wei blo Zizas, po teke dempla go ane pute dempla insaid zeilaus wea Zarusalem po panis dempla.
‘So ai bin go. Baut melendei klostu po Damaskas, stretwei prapa braitlait wase laitning prom eben bin sain raitraun wea mi.
Ai bin poldaun wea graun ane ai bin lisen bois i spik, “Saulu, Saulu, aukam yu meke ol badting gense mi?”
‘Ai bin aske em, “Uda yu bos?” ‘Da BosLod i bin ansa, “Mi Zizas prom Nazaret. Mi da wan yu oltaim eitem, meke nugudwei.”
Dem man uda i bin de wea mi, ol bin mata stanap kuaiat. Dempla no bin lisen da bois, bat dempla bin luk da lait.
‘So ai bin aske da BosLod, “Wanem yu wande mi po mekem a?” ‘Em bin spik mi, “Gedap nau, stanap ane go insaid po taun blo Damaskas. Sambodi de i go spik yu ebriting wanem yu go mekem.”
‘Dat braitlait i bin meke ai blo mi blain. So dem met blo mi bin kese an blo mi ane lide mi go po Damaskas.
I bin gad wan man de, uda bin biliba, neim blo em Ananas. Em i bin stap de wea Damaskas. Em bin pole dem lo blo Mozes. Ol dem Zuwispipol bin prapa laik em ane bin prapa rispekt em.
Em bin kam de po mi ane em bin stanap klostu wea mi ane em i bin spik po mi, “Bala, Saulu yu nomo blain nau.” Stretwei ai blo mi i bin kamgud ane ai ken lukgen.
‘Den Ananas i bin spik mi diskain, “Da God blo yumpla bipotaim pamlelain, i bin suze yu po sabe da wei blo God. Yu go luk da prapa Rait ane Stretwan prom God ane yu go lisen bois blo em.
Yu mas gobi witnis blo em ane spik ebribodi wanem yu bin luk ane lisen ya.
Yu no weit! Gedap ane baptaiz, prea solong God i go pogibe ol nugudwei blo yu.”
‘Apta nau ai bin gobaigen po Zarusalem. Wen ai bin prea wea da Tempol blo God ai bin luk bizin.
Ai bin luk da BosLod, em bin tok po mi. Em bin spik diskain, “Ariap gowei prom Zarusalem bikoz dempla ya nogo wande lisen wanem yu bin witnis baut mi.”
‘Den ai bin tok baigen po em, “BosLod, dempla sabe ai bin go wea dem zuwispreaus. Ai bin gibe oda po kese dem pipol uda bilib wea yu ane ai bin ploke dempla ane sake dempla insaid wea zeilaus.
Ane wen Stibin i bin spikbaut yu, dempla i bin kile em. Ai bin gri wea dempla po kile em bikoz ai bin stanap lugaut ol klos blo dempla wail dempla i bin sake ston po kile em.”
‘Bat den da BosLod i bin spik po mi, “Go. Go nau! Ai go sane yu go longwei prom ya, po dempla uda Nozuwispipol.” ’
Ol dem pipol bin lisen Pol tok raitap antil nau. Bat wen em bin spik dis tok dempla bin stat singaut prapa laudwan, ‘Kilem! I nugud em go stap laipwan. Kilem!’
Dempla bin singaut molaud ane bin tekemaut kout blo dempla ane bin pikemap graun ane sake dast ebriwea.
Pol spik em gad rait wase man blo Rom
Da bigamibos bin spik dem amiman po teke Pol go insaid da amibarik. Den em bin gibe oda po ploke em, bikoz em bin wande meke Pol konpes wanem rong em bin mekem po meke dem pipol graul wea em laudwan.

Bat wen dempla i bin mekpas Pol so dempla ken ploke em, Pol i bin spik po da sekan amiopisa uda bin stanap klostu wea em. Pol i bin spik, ‘Ei yu! Yu lau po ploke man uda gad rait wase man prom Rom, bipo yupla teke em po kot a?’
Wen da sekan amiopisa i bin lisen dis tok, em bin atzamp ane bin go spik da bigamibos. ‘Ei, wanem yu mekem? Dis man em i gad rait wase man prom Rom.’
Den da bigamibos i bin kam aske Pol, ‘Yu gad rait wase man blo Rom a?’ Pol i bin ansa, ‘Wa!’

Da bigamibos i bin spik, ‘Ai bin pei plenti mani po dem lida blo Rom po gede mai rait wase dem pipol blo Rom.’ Pol i bin ansa, ‘Wel, ai gad rait wase man blo Rom bikoz papa ane mama blo mi i bin gad dis rait.’

Orait. Seimtaim nau ol dem amiman uda i bin wande kuestin ane ploke Pol, ol bin prait ane bin mub kuikwan gowei prom em. Da bigamibos i bin prait tu wen em bin lisen Pol gad rait wase man blo Rom, bikoz em bin gibe da oda po taiemape Pol.
Pol spik wea da Zuwiskaunsil

Da neksdei da bigamibos i bin oda ol dem edprist po kam tugeda po miting wea da Zuwiskaunsil po paindaut wanem dem Zuwisman i bin gad gense Pol. Ane em bin oda dem man po tekemaut dem sein prom Pol ane po teke em kam insaid ane meke em stanap prant melen wea ebriwan.
